title: DurtleWeapons
description: Custom weapon reskins for Durtle Empire SMP.
body:
# DurtleWeapons
is a mod made for the Durtle Empire SMP to give its players custom tool skins.

It adds a multitude of reskinned netherite tools, including textures and death messages. All items are currently survival unobatinable.

This was originally a datapack trying and hilariously failing to give specific items custom death messages. This endeavour caused the slow death of the server as it turned out the datapack was not deleting scoreboard entries after making them and racked up almost a hundred thousand before the server stopped working and we had to go looking for the issue.
